tutorial_data.imgCaption: Buka instagram lalu masuk ke menu profile dan klik icon hamburger
tutorial_data.imgCaptionEnglish: Open Instagram, go to your profile menu, and tap the hamburger icon

tutorial_data.imgCaption: Pilih akun yang akan diexport datanya
tutorial_data.imgCaptionEnglish: Choose the account whose data you want to export

tutorial_data.imgCaption: Setelah itu pilih Export to device
Lalu pada custom information ini cukup centang yang 'Followers and following'
tutorial_data.imgCaptionEnglish: In the custom information section, check only 'Followers and Following'

tutorial_data.imgCaption: Lalu atur Date range ke All time dan Format ke JSON, sesuaikan seperti pada gambar
tutorial_data.imgCaptionEnglish: Then set the Date Range to All time and Format to JSON, just like in the image

tutorial_data.imgCaption: Setelah semua sudah disesuikan klik Start export
tutorial_data.imgCaptionEnglish: Once everything is set, tap Start Export

tutorial_data.imgCaption: Setelah selesai tunggu sekitar 2-3 jam atau tunggu notifikasi dari Instagram jika data sudah siap diunduh
tutorial_data.imgCaptionEnglish: After that, wait about 2–3 hours or until you receive a notification from Instagram that your data is ready to download

tutorial_data.imgCaption: Jika sudah siap datanya akan tampil seperti di gambar, lalu Download
tutorial_data.imgCaptionEnglish: Once your data is ready, it will appear like in the image — then tap Download

tutorial_data.imgCaption: Extract file-nya masuk ke folder connections > followers_and_following lalu cari file yang akan diupload sesuai namanya pada halaman Upload nanti
tutorial_data.imgCaptionEnglish: Extract the file, go to the connections > followers_and_following folder, and find the file that will be uploaded later on the Upload page
